name: Eliezer (Abram's servant from Damascus)
title: Abraham's Trusted Servant
summary: Eliezer of Damascus was Abraham's most trusted servant and steward of his household. Before Isaac was born, Eliezer was designated as Abraham's heir. He is best known for the mission to find a wife for Isaac, a task he carried out with faithfulness, prayer, and reverence for God.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Abraham's Heir
keyEvents.description: Abraham complained to God that he was childless and that Eliezer of Damascus, a servant born in his house, would inherit all he owned. However, God promised Abraham that his own son would be his heir.

keyEvents.title: Sent to Find a Wife for Isaac
keyEvents.description: Abraham tasked Eliezer with traveling to his relatives in Mesopotamia to find a wife for Isaac and made him swear not to take a Canaanite woman for Isaac.

keyEvents.title: Eliezer's Prayer at the Well
keyEvents.description: When Eliezer arrived at the city of Nahor, he prayed to God for a sign at the well: The young woman who offered water to both him and his camels would be the one God had chosen for Isaac.

keyEvents.title: Rebekah Fulfills the Sign
keyEvents.description: Rebekah came to the well and fulfilled exactly the sign Eliezer had asked for. She gave him a drink and also watered all his camels, showing her hospitality and servant's heart.

keyEvents.title: Eliezer Tells of His Mission to Bethuel and Laban
keyEvents.description: Eliezer was invited into Bethuel's house, where he spoke about Abraham's wealth, his mission, and how God had led him to Rebekah. Bethuel and Laban agreed that Rebekah could go with him.

keyEvents.title: Rebekah Is Brought to Isaac
keyEvents.description: Eliezer faithfully completed his mission and brought Rebekah back to Canaan, where she met Isaac and became his wife. Isaac found comfort in her after the death of his mother Sarah.
